title: 纸界远行

selectedMaster.selection: 首轮目视：一人一犬立于有完整折面和侧截面的纸地台，右上书页岛与折纸路径可辨；书页/纸片上出现细小拟文字纹理，后续统一复核时需决定是否消除。仅执行者暂选母版，未做用户审美复核。

generationRuns.prompt: Create ONE original full-frame opaque vertical 2:3 tarot illustration (1024x1536), The Fool theme 纸界远行 / Journey Through the Paper Realm. Use the supplied original solely as identity and painterly tarot style reference: exactly one youthful dark-haired traveler in ivory shirt and deep ink-blue/violet windblown cloak, a shoulder staff with a clearly tied bundle, accompanied by exactly one small white dog with four discernible legs. Entirely new imaginative scene, physically crafted from layered folded paper and delicately painted: the two stand at the LOWER CENTER entrance to a broad origami canyon. Folded paper mountains and ink-drawn valleys recede on both left and right; a hovering island of open book pages awaits in the UPPER RIGHT, joined visually by a winding paper path. Their supporting foreground paper platform has obvious folded top planes, substantial complete cross-section and full sides continuing to the lower bleed, so feet and paws have secure contact. Warm white paper, deep ink blue shadows, very restrained vermilion accents; subtle visible fiber texture, beautiful hand-painted details and depth. Fine narrow celestial gold tarot border, no words or letters on the pages, no title, no printed symbols, no watermark or logo. Staff passes behind the head without touching it; bundle tie obvious; no second traveler, no extra dog, no extra limbs, no floating bodies, no cropped support. This must differ unmistakably from cliff, cloud harbor, desert oasis, and snowy bridge imagery. Deliver one complete layered-looking but opaque master painting.
generationRuns.conclusion: Selected opaque master provisionally after first-pass visual check; no transparent layers or assembly.
